name: Ebrotidine

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in Peru and Spain, first in 1998 — for liver harm

summary: Ebrotidine was taken off the market in Spain and Peru starting in 1998 due to harm it caused to the liver [3]. Additionally, a small computer model evaluated the drug rather than tests on people, estimating a high score of 80 for liver issues [M]. The same computer model estimated a low score of 37 for heart issues [M].
